title: Rice农业娇宠：从种子到丰收的全貌 春种秋收
reason: The video describes various farming techniques and sustainable practices.

tasks.task: Describe rice planting and its cultivation process.

subtasks.text: Observe the selection of rice seeds that are carefully chosen for their resilience and suitability to local conditions.
Note the process of planting rice seeds by hand in a prepared patty, emphasizing the labor involved.
Notice the flooded field (patty) created for rice cultivation and the importance of a well-prepared environment for the rice to grow.
Look at the use of organic matter, such as compost or manure, to enrich the soil and enhance its fertility.
Mention the importance of leveling the field to ensure even water distribution.

tasks.task: Describe the importance of water management in rice cultivation.

subtasks.text: Inspect the role of water as a temperature regulator for the rice plants.
Observe how water helps suppress weeds, giving the rice plants a competitive advantage.
Note that root vegetables like carrots and potatoes are ready for harvest when their foliage dies back.
Highlight the use of hand harvesting for leafy greens like lettuce and herbs.

tasks.task: Describe the importance of sustainable agriculture.

subtasks.text: Observe the use of the system of rice intensification or SRI for reducing water usage.
Note the adoption of organic farming practices to build soil fertility and control pests.
